title: Rust Leviathan
description: An FM bass-drone that wakes from a clean low hum and slowly rusts apart: the crusher and downsampler bite deeper across the loop while the FM index climbs into clangorous metal, dragging harmonics from sub-fundamental up to a shrieking treble snarl. By the end it's a broken, full-spectrum leviathan groan before resetting to its quiet origin.
code:
setcpm(84/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 <eb1 g0> c1>/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1.5, 13)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/8")
    .penv("<0 0 7 -12>/16").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.4)
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 3.5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 8>/8")
    .shape(sine.slow(20).range(0.1, 0.6))
    .lpf(sine.slow(28).range(180, 4200)).resonance(saw.slow(16).range(4, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.3)
    .vib("<3 5>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.3).sustain(0.7).release(0.2)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .off(1/4, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).crush(5).pan(0.75))
    .room(sine.slow(40).range(0.1, 0.45)).delay("0.4:0.5:0.55")
    .gain(0.88)
)
